name: Studio Tour Section
summary: Contextual studio walkthrough profile composed from Process Timeline with optional introduction and target-owned supplementary media.

anatomy.name: rootProfile
anatomy.description: Studio-tour context hook layered on the required canonical Process Timeline section and named by its visible contextual heading.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Contextual introduction containing the required heading and any optional eyebrow or intro.

anatomy.name: eyebrow
anatomy.description: Optional editorial label that never substitutes for the required heading.

anatomy.name: heading
anatomy.description: Required visible contextual heading using canonical Process Timeline title presentation and labelling the root and ordered lane.

anatomy.name: intro
anatomy.description: Optional concise introduction to the ordered studio walkthrough.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.description: Required canonical Process Timeline native ordered lane labelled by the visible tour heading.

anatomy.name: step
anatomy.description: Direct repeated canonical Process Timeline list item supplied by the target.

anatomy.name: stepNumber
anatomy.description: Canonical visible sequence marker hidden from assistive technology because native ordered-list semantics expose position.

anatomy.name: stepImage
anatomy.description: Optional canonical passive step-media region omitted completely when absent.

anatomy.name: stepTitle
anatomy.description: Required contextual heading for one tour stop.

anatomy.name: stepDescription
anatomy.description: Optional concise description of one tour stop.

anatomy.name: media
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned supplementary-media composition; the neutral fixture is a passive native figure.

anatomy.name: mediaAsset
anatomy.description: Optional native media asset whose type, source, alternative, loading and interaction are supplied by the target.

anatomy.name: mediaCaption
anatomy.description: Optional target-authored caption for the self-contained supplementary media.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Default contextual Studio Tour profile of canonical Process Timeline.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Canonical Process Timeline tracks distribute available inline space and overflow natively only when required.

states.name: default
states.description: Required visible heading and ordered steps with any accepted optional introduction, step content and supplementary media.

states.name: trackFocus
states.description: Canonical visible keyboard focus on the native lane when overflowing steps require keyboard scrolling.

behavior.name: processTimelineComposition
behavior.description: Studio Tour consumes canonical Process Timeline anatomy, ordered semantics, numbering, optional step media/descriptions, intrinsic overflow, focus, RTL, forced colors and zero-runtime behavior without recreating them.

behavior.name: requiredComposition
behavior.description: Targets render the profile only with a non-empty visible heading and at least one ordered step. The root and lane reference one target-unique heading id; invalid required composition is omitted.

behavior.name: orderedTour
behavior.description: Targets use a native ordered list with direct list items and preserve meaningful authored tour order independently of available inline size.

behavior.name: optionalIntroduction
behavior.description: Optional eyebrow and intro parts are independently omitted without empty wrappers and never replace the required visible heading.

behavior.name: optionalStepContent
behavior.description: Canonical optional image and description parts are independently omitted while required number/title order remains understandable.

behavior.name: mediaOwnership
behavior.description: The optional supplementary-media slot chooses no media type, provider, source, consent, loading, controls, captions, transcript, playback, modal, analytics or poster behavior. The neutral fixture remains passive.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Localized, unbroken, repeated, short, long and zoomed content remains contained; only the named canonical lane can scroll horizontally.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: Studio Tour owns no controlled or uncontrolled state, listener, observer, timer, request, player, custom key handling, live region, animation, icon, asset or network work. Data and media lifecycle remain target responsibilities.

properties.name: eyebrow
properties.description: Optional editorial label shown above the required heading.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: Required non-empty visible tour heading used as the section and ordered-lane label; contextual native heading rank remains target-owned.

properties.name: steps
properties.description: Required target-owned canonical Process Timeline composition with at least one step title and optional step media/descriptions.

properties.name: media
properties.description: Optional target-owned supplementary media and caption; no media type or playback behavior is implied.

accessibility: Render the profile only with a non-empty visible contextual heading and at least one direct ordered-list item; omit invalid required composition.
Associate the native section and canonical ordered lane with the same visible heading through a target-unique aria-labelledby/id pair.

Use canonical Process Timeline native ol/li semantics, preserve authored source order, keep native lane scrolling and do not add Timeline widget, progress, carousel, current-step or selection semantics.
Keep the visible decimal marker aria-hidden because native ordered-list semantics expose position; never rely on marker, connector, image or scroll position for sequence.
Give informative step and supplementary images useful target-authored alternative text, use alt="" for decorative images, and omit empty optional wrappers.
Keep the neutral supplementary-media fixture passive with no focus stop. A target-supplied player needs complete keyboard-accessible controls, captions, descriptions and transcripts as applicable.
Do not autoplay or load third-party media by neutral-contract assumption; provider, privacy, consent, loading, playback, modal and analytics remain target-owned.
Allow localized, unbroken, repeated and 200-percent-zoom content to remain contained without page-level horizontal overflow.

web.notes: Implemented as a contextual profile of canonical Process Timeline with source-owned introduction and passive supplementary-media presentation; no neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Can compose ordered Process Timeline blocks plus optional editorial settings/media after merchant record schema and media policy are selected; no generic Liquid player is authorized.
